title: 第六章 元宵灯会 二

content_zh:
不过好处就是，几人中特别是林新，掌握了红松剑法后，胆气大增。又被拉着去林子里杀了一些野物，见了血，算是镇定稳得多了。
“正好过几天元宵节，我也要回家一次，师妹和我一起去，你们两个就在这里守家。”林新吩咐。
“哦...”路云兄妹有气无力的应了声。
“回来给你们带礼物。”林新补了句。
顿时两人又高兴起来。
“多谢师兄！”
摇摇头，吃过饭，林新又安排了下安颖，叮嘱她要准备什么东西，注意什么东西，这才回到自己房间。
继续加练红松剑法，红松剑法其实只有三招，松阳针，大松阳针，定真还阳，三个绝招。其他都只是基本的剑招，点，刺，削，挑，撩等。
步伐则是配套的红松步，有种稳打稳扎的风格。
站在房间内，林新看了眼属性栏，红松剑法中三招技能都有了，这都是他不断尝试得出的完美剑招，只要点上去，就是最完美标准的模范剑招。
“可惜小归元诀没法练...”林新惋惜的看了眼桌上放着的秘技，这玩意被师叔伯云子还了回来，上边是小归元诀直到第五层的全部功法。
沉下心，林新继续习练红松剑法，虽然剑招都已经掌握，不过到底时间不长，要把其练成身体本能还是需要很长时间的。
练了数遍后，他气喘吁吁，浑身冒汗，双手酸痛得厉害。
坐到桌边休息，随手拿起秘技翻看起来，这上边的小归元诀已经被他翻得滚瓜烂熟。
不料翻了几页，他忽然看到里面居然还有一本小册子。土黄色，表面有些破烂，有些褶皱，似乎是被人经常翻阅。
“这是....？”林新拿起这本小册子。
册子表面龙飞凤舞的写了《归元要领》四个字。显然是伯云子故意放在这里的。
翻开册子，林新仔细一点点的详读。
时间一点一滴的过去，不知不觉间，油灯嚓的一声炸响，顿时惊醒了沉浸在册子中的林新。
他迅速添了灯油，但眉目的喜色却是难以掩饰。

再度拿起这本小册子，他狠狠吸了口气。
“没想到还有这个绕开限制的办法。”
这上边纪录了一种丹药，名叫归元丹。正是为无法修习小归元诀的弟子而创立的。
这丹药可不是丹炉里面炼出来的，而是药膏凝聚而成。
不过归元丹最大的麻烦不是这个，而是它需要的药引子很是艰难。需要一种名叫长耳虎的热血，当做水配合服下，连服五颗，马上行气，才有效果。
长耳虎红松山倒是附近有，但是....
林新心头有些打鼓，长耳虎可是货真价实的老虎，据说极少有人见过，性情异常狡猾，传说听力尤其厉害。
“过几天就是元宵节，或者可以回去问问，看家里有没有什么办法。顺便也把需要的药材买齐。”他想到自己这个身体是有着本地大族身份的背景，或许能够想到办法。
上辈子他就特别迷内功什么的东西，现在有了这个机会，不好好把握那就真的是暴殄天物了。
**************************
三天后......
城外人来人往，车水马龙的城门道上，三辆黑漆四方马车缓缓朝着城门驶去。混着前后有些拥挤的车流，马车车夫挥鞭详做要抽打，顿时吓开了周围围上来卖东西的小孩。
随着车辆逐渐接近红松城城门，很快城内迎来一行人，身穿黑马甲，为首的男子戴着黑色圆帽笑容满面。迅速将三辆马车迎进城。
顺着分叉的街道，三辆马车又走了约莫十多分钟，终于到了一座红漆大门的大户门口。
大门已经敞开了，有门房守在门口躬身笑眯眯的看着马车停下。
“欢迎二小姐三爷四爷回家！”门房大声恭敬的喊起来。
马车上各自下来一位年轻人，两男一女，两个男子容貌俊朗，一个肤色偏黑，一个隐约有点威严。
那个女子却是珠光宝气一身淡黄色绸裙，手上脖子上都戴了珍珠和玉石链子。面容娇美，身材微微有些丰满，不过更显得成熟妩媚。
大门内，一身白色宽衣的林志文带着几个妇人已经笑呵呵的迎了出来。和三个儿女低声交谈了几句，也不知道是说了什么，惹得他大笑起来。

content_en:
But the good thing is that among the few people, especially Lin Xin, their courage has greatly increased after mastering the red pine sword technique. He was taken to the woods to kill some wild animals. After seeing the blood, he felt much calmer and more stable.
"It happens that the Lantern Festival is just a few days away, and I have to go home. Junior sister and I will go together, and you two will stay here to guard the house." Lin Xin ordered.
"Oh..." Brother and sister Lu Yun responded weakly.
"I'll bring you gifts when I come back." Lin Xin added.
Suddenly the two of them became happy again.
"Thank you, senior brother!"
Shaking his head, after eating, Lin Xin arranged for An Ying again, telling her what to prepare and what to pay attention to, and then returned to his room.
Continue to practice the red pine sword technique. There are actually only three moves in the red pine sword technique, the pine yang needle, the big pine yang needle, and the Ding Zhen returning yang, three unique moves. Others are just basic sword moves, point, stab, slice, pick, tease, etc.
The pace is matching red pine steps, with a steady style.
Standing in the room, Lin Xin glanced at the attribute bar. He saw that the three moves in the Red Pine Sword Technique were available. These were the perfect sword moves he had obtained through constant attempts. As long as he clicked on them, they would be the most perfect and standard model sword moves.
"It's a pity that Xiao Guiyuan Jue can't be practiced..." Lin Xin looked at the secret skills on the table with regret. This thing was returned by his uncle Yunzi. On it were all the skills from Xiao Guiyuan Jue to the fifth level.
After calming down, Lin Xin continued to practice the red pine sword technique. Although he had mastered all the sword moves, it didn't take long, and it would still take a long time to develop it into a physical instinct.
After practicing several times, he was out of breath, sweating all over, and his hands were sore.
He sat down at the table to rest, picked up the Secret Technique and looked through it, and found that the Little Guiyuan Jue above was already familiar to him.
Unexpectedly, after turning a few pages, he suddenly saw that there was a booklet inside. It is khaki in color, with some tatters and wrinkles on the surface. It seems that it has been read through frequently.
"Is this...?" Lin Xin picked up the booklet.
The four words "Essentials for Returning to Yuan" are written in flying colors on the surface of the booklet. Obviously Boyunzi put it here deliberately.
Opening the booklet, Lin Xin read it carefully bit by bit.
Time passed bit by bit, and before he knew it, the oil lamp exploded, suddenly waking up Lin Xin who was immersed in the book.
He quickly added lamp oil, but the joy on his face could not be concealed.
Picking up the booklet again, he took a deep breath.
"I didn't expect there was such a way to get around the restrictions."
There is a kind of elixir recorded here called Guiyuan Dan. It was created just for the disciples who are unable to practice the Xiao Gui Yuan Jue.
This elixir is not refined in the elixir furnace, but is condensed from ointment.
But the biggest trouble with Guiyuan Pill is not this, but the introduction of the medicine it requires is very difficult. It requires a kind of warm blood called long-eared tiger, which can be taken with water. Take five pills in a row to release the Qi immediately, and then it will be effective.
There are long-eared tigers and red pine trees nearby, but...
Lin Xin was a little worried. The long-eared tiger was a real tiger. It was said that few people had seen it. It had an extremely cunning temperament and was said to have a particularly good hearing.
"The Lantern Festival will be in a few days, or you can go back and ask if there is any way at home. By the way, buy all the needed medicinal materials." He thought that his body had the background of a local wealthy family, and he might be able to think of a way.
In his previous life, he was particularly fascinated by internal strength and other things. Now that he had this opportunity, it would be a waste if he didn't take advantage of it.
***************************
Three days later...
People were coming and going outside the city, and on the busy city gate road, three black square carriages drove slowly towards the city gate. Mixed with the somewhat crowded traffic in front and behind, the carriage driver whipped his whip in detail, frightening away the children who were surrounding him to sell things.
As the vehicle gradually approached the gate of Red Pine City, soonA group of people were welcomed into the city, wearing black vests, and the leader was a man wearing a black round hat and smiling broadly. Quickly welcome the three carriages into the city.
Following the bifurcated streets, the three carriages walked for about ten minutes, and finally arrived at the entrance of a large red-painted door.
The door was already open, and a concierge stood guarding the door, bowing and smiling as he watched the carriage stop.
"Welcome home, Miss Second, Third Master and Fourth Master!" the concierge shouted loudly and respectfully.
A young man got off the carriage, two men and one woman. The two men were handsome, one had a dark complexion, and the other was vaguely majestic.
The woman was dressed in a light yellow silk dress, with pearls and jade chains on her hands and neck. She has a pretty face and a slightly plump figure, but she looks more mature and charming.
Inside the gate, Lin Zhiwen, dressed in white loose clothes, and several women came out with a smile. He whispered a few words to his three children, but he didn't know what he said, which made him laugh.
